Annual death probabilities for a life aged x

Source: R/mortality.R
q_path.Rd

Returns q for durations 0, 1, 2, ... until the limiting age, where the last probability is set to 1. Optional select mortality and extra risk are applied in this order: age rating, select factors, then an addition to the force of mortality or a multiple of q.

Usage

q_path(m, x, select = NULL, extra = NULL, max_age = 120)

Arguments

m

A mortality object from mortality_law().

x

Issue age.

select

NULL for ultimate mortality, or a list with factors, the multipliers applied to q in the first select years (for example list(factors = c(0.7, 0.85))).

extra

NULL, or a list describing extra risk: list(type = "age", years = 5), list(type = "add_mu", delta = 0.005) or list(type = "mult_q", k = 1.5).

max_age

Limiting age for laws without one.

Value

A numeric vector of one-year death probabilities.
